response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Only products that appear in Order_Items are included. Products with no order-item lines are not counted in the average share, so the average equals 1 divided by the number of distinct ordered products.
An order-item line is one row of Order_Items. Product_quantity is ignored.
